name: One version
description: One VERSION of one model, by id. A permalink, and public once the version is: `active`, `disabled` (a baseline switched off) or `superseded`. A version still being admitted, waiting for its trial or rejected is its owner's, read through GET /v1/me/versions/{id}, and answers 404 here -- the rejection reason and the trial in progress are not the world's to read. The shape is version_json(), which the model's list and the owner's route return too, so the three cannot disagree. The successor is THE SAME ENTRY'S next version, in the same season. `class_max_bytes` comes from the version's own season, because a cap is the season's and a closed season keeps its own.

with.name: No public version
with.description: No such version, or one that is not public yet or never will be.
